goal: Successfully book an Annual Health Checkup for employee and spouse
constraints: Use testdata values. Appointment date must be at least 5 days from today. Use plausible Indian names, cities, phone numbers.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

phases.description: Open the conversation and state health checkup intent
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has greeted the user and offered to book an appointment

phases.description: Select Employee with Spouse booking type and provide spouse details
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted the spouse DOB and asked for the appointment date

phases.description: Provide a valid future appointment date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted the appointment date and asked for mobile number
phases.recoveryHint: Use 22nd May 2026 or a date at least 5 days in the future

phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted the mobile number and asked for state
Bot has presented clinic selection for the city

phases.description: Click Select on a clinic card
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the booking for the employee and spouse

name: AHC Employee with Spouse happy flow
